title: BOX OF DR DOLITTE & OTHER CHIL...
reason: Complete 12 volume jacketed Doctor Dolittle set plus Benn Nesbit editions; value depends on the edition, which the photos do not identify.
findings: Complete looking set of 12 Hugh Lofting Doctor Dolittle hardbacks in dust jackets, a uniform edition with coloured spine bands and an animal emblem for each title: The Story of Doctor Dolittle, Doctor Dolittle in the Moon, Doctor Dolittle's Return, Caravan, Garden, Post Office, Circus, Puddleby Adventures, The Voyages of Doctor Dolittle, Doctor Dolittle and the Green Canary, Doctor Dolittle and the Secret Lake, and Doctor Dolittle's Zoo. The publisher is not legible on the spines, so the edition and date are unknown (jackets look 1960s to 1970s). Also six E. Nesbit hardbacks in jackets marked BENN on the spines (The Railway Children, The Story of the Amulet, The Story of the Treasure Seekers, The Wouldbegoods, Five Children and It, The Phoenix and the Carpet), 'The Magic World' by E. Nesbit (green cloth, gilt title, jacket) and an Emily Rodda Deltora Quest 3 'Isle of the Dead' Scholastic slipcase box.
condition: Jackets look bright and clean with light shelf wear and tanned page edges; the Nesbit jackets show a little soiling; the Deltora box has worn corners and a creased spine. Internal condition unknown.
rescore_note: Complete 12 volume jacketed Doctor Dolittle uniform set (jackets look 1960s to 70s, publisher not legible, so a later reprint rather than a first), six jacketed Benn Nesbit titles, The Magic World and a Deltora Quest slipcase; bright and saleable as sets but common reprints; $80-200 band. No comp seen.
